name: Redis (Upstash)
description: Serverless Redis via Upstash — caching, rate limiting, pub/sub, and queues with an HTTP-based SDK.
postInstallNotes:
1. Create a free Redis database at console.upstash.com and copy the REST URL and token.
2. Use `getCache` / `setCache` for simple key-value storage with optional TTL.
3. Use `rateLimit('user:123', 10, 60)` to allow 10 requests per minute per user.
